title: Analytics
subtitle: Your application funnel and technology demand — all computed from real data.

empty.title: Empty for now
empty.hint: Add vacancies and their stack — the charts will fill in on their own.

funnelReached.heading: How many vacancies ever reached this stage
funnelReached.description: Unlike the "Application funnel" above (where things stand now), this shows how many vacancies passed through each stage at least once, ever, regardless of how it ended up (e.g. a rejection at the interview stage still counts here).

conversion.heading: Conversion between stages
conversion.description: What share of vacancies that reached a stage also reached the next one — shows where your funnel actually "filters".

stageDurations.heading: Where each step "gets stuck" the longest
stageDurations.description: Average number of days between a vacancy entering this stage and its next status change.

radar.title: Skill radar
radar.subtitle: Your skills against real market demand (computed from the stack of added vacancies). Where green is smaller than purple — that's a gap.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.hint: Add vacancies or analyze their stack — and the radar will show up automatically.
